definitions.confident: Bakta (extra) product match and/or CANT-HYD HMM (trusted cutoff); putative = coordinate-remapped eggNOG KO only
definitions.mge_borne: geNomad plasmid with >=1 hallmark or conjugation genes (score>=0.9), geNomad virus contig (>=2 hallmarks, score>=0.95, CheckV host<viral), geNomad provirus, IslandPath island, or IntegronFinder integron (+-1 kb)
definitions.IS_within_10kb: transposase/IS/integrase/resolvase (Bakta product, excl. RecA/Xer/Ruv) within 10 kb
definitions.hgt_candidate: >=95% aa id & >=80% cov (mmseqs), >=99% nt identity, different genus (GTDB/Kaiju harmonised), DNA depth-profile rho<0.2 across 276 nanopore samples (same-MAG contigs median 0.60, random -0.52); flank test: identical block in otherwise unaligned +-20 kb flanks
